bio: Nestled in a quiet location on the outskirts of town, Hotel Freiwerk's core building is a spruce half-timbered villa dating from 1894. Its restaurant, 20zwanzig, is housed in the modern extension, built in 2020. The chic, trendy interior has a large window front that affords a splendid view of the surrounding greenery. You can order the contemporary seasonal cuisine à la carte or opt for a surprise menu comprising a variable number of courses. Friendly and well-trained waitstaff....
